mapper.insert: INSERT INTO member (id, pw, name, phone, email, address, gender, birth, status) VALUES (#{id}, #{pw}, #{name}, #{phone}, #{email}, #{address},#{gender}, #{birth}, 'USER')
mapper.update: UPDATE member SET name = #{name}, pw = #{pw}, phone = #{phone}, email = #{email}, address = #{address}, gender = #{gender}, birth = #{birth}, update_Time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM member WHERE name = #{name} AND phone = #{phone}
